companies.name: TCS

facts: Batches 2024, 2025, 2026 with B.E/B.Tech/M.E/M.Tech/MCA/M.Sc/M.S from AICTE/UGC recognised institutions
Minimum 60% aggregate (or equivalent CGPA) across class 10, 12, diploma if any, graduation and PG if any
No pending backlog when appearing for selection
Up to 2 years work experience allowed

Test: 190 min integrated NQT. Part A Foundation 75 min (numerical 25, verbal 25, reasoning 25). Part B Advanced 115 min (advanced quant and reasoning 25, advanced coding 90). In-centre mode at TCS iON centre
Listed CTC ranges: Prime 9.09-9.30 LPA (UG, 0-1 yr), Digital 7.09-7.30 LPA; actual pay depends on experience and location (as stated by TCS)
